subject.title: Gateway silently skips channel initialization on plugin/runtime mismatch or missing module files

question: For configured channels that fail before registration, should Gateway remain fail-open with explicit startup/status/doctor health warnings, or should it fail fast or attempt automatic plugin repair/reload?
rationale: The remaining behavior changes upgrade semantics, plugin trust, operator recovery, and runtime reload policy; source evidence shows a narrow warning fix exists, but the broader contract is a maintainer product/security decision.

options.title: Fail open with loud health audit
options.body: Keep Gateway startup available, but add a complete configured-channel attempted/loaded/failed audit across startup logs, status, and doctor, and route drift and bundled-module repairs to explicit recovery commands.

options.title: Fail fast for configured channel blockers
options.body: Make incompatible or missing configured channel plugins block startup with an actionable error, accepting a stronger operator signal at the cost of upgrade compatibility risk.

options.title: Split and close narrower work
options.body: Treat #96397 as the startup-warning fix, move plugin drift to #83337, bundled missing modules to #86039/#96943, and open separate product items for hot reload and performance if maintainers still want them.

recommendation.title: Fail open with loud health audit
recommendation.body: Keep Gateway startup available, but add a complete configured-channel attempted/loaded/failed audit across startup logs, status, and doctor, and route drift and bundled-module repairs to explicit recovery commands.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision is closest to plugin activation, channel startup planning, and gateway startup policy, where recent history points most strongly to vincentkoc.
